title: Cypher Almanach - Modern Glassmorphic Journal
description: A high-performance, frameless, dark glassmorphic Journal sheet for Foundry VTT storing fully unsanitized HTML/CSS/JS in document flags, with pixel-perfect iframe rendering (fit-to-width default, fit-page, manual zoom, click-and-drag panning), a custom draggable header that collapses into a labeled overflow menu on narrow windows, WYSIWYG editor, UUID linking, ownership permissions, selective player broadcasting, and Cypher System triggers.
